<h2 id="tocS_PreviewAppActionsPutAction">PreviewAppActionsPutAction</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapreviewappactionsputaction"></a>
<a id="schema_PreviewAppActionsPutAction"></a>
<a id="tocSpreviewappactionsputaction"></a>
<a id="tocspreviewappactionsputaction"></a>

```json
{
  "mappings": [
    {
      "destField": "string",
      "srcType": "FIELD",
      "srcField": "string"
    }
  ],
  "entities": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "type": "USER"
    }
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "index": 0,
  "filterCond": "string",
  "destApp": {
    "app": 0,
    "code": "string"
  }
}
```

An object listing `Action` information of 1 `Action`.
If _actionname_ is equal to the name of an existing `Action`, the `Action` will be updated with the values in the object.
If _actionname_ is not equal to a name of an existing `Action`, a new `Action` will be created with the values in the object.
Any existing `Action` that is not set for this parameter will be deleted.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|mappings|[object]|false|none|An array of objects containing the **Field Mappings** options.<br>If the array is empty, the `Action` will not have **Field Mappings** options set.<br>Required when specifying the `actions.{actionname}.destApp` parameter, or creating a new `Action`.|
|entities|[[PreviewAppActionsPutEntity](#schemapreviewappactionsputentity)]|false|none|An array of objects containing the entities the `Action` is granted to.<br>This reflects the **Available To** options.<br>If the array is empty, the `Action` will not be available to any users/departments/groups.<br>Required when creating a new `Action`.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the `Action`.<br>1 to 32 characters can be specified.<br>When creating a new `Action`, the request will fail if this parameter's value is not the same as `actions.{actionname}`.<br>Required when updating an existing `Action`, or creating a new `Action`.|
|index|integer(int64)|true|none|The order of the `Actions`.<br>The `Action` is sorted in ascending order, starting from 0.<br>The request will fail if there are duplicate values.<br>Required when updating an existing `Action`, or creating a new `Action`.|
|filterCond|string|false|none|The query string that App Action can be used.<br>If ignored, the condition will not be changed.<br>If an empty string is specified when creating or updating the `Action`, the condition will be set as `All records`.<br>For more information on query string, refer to the following article:<br>[Query string](https://kintone.dev/en/docs/kintone/overview/query-string/)<br>There are restrictions on the conditions that can be specified:<br>[Available Operators and Functions for Each Field](https://kintone.dev/en/id/0d9792ee2b6e4b0e3829c9ee/#available-operators-and-functions-for-each-field)|
|destApp|object|false|none|An object containing the Target option that specifies the destination App where data is to be copied.<br>Required when creating a new `Action`.|

|format|string|false|none|The display format for fields with calculations:<br>- `NUMBER`: Number (e.g.: 1000)<br>- `NUMBER_DIGIT`: Number with thousands separator (e.g.: 1,000)<br>- `DATETIME`: Date & time (e.g.: Aug 06, 2012 2:03 PM)<br>- `DATE`: Date (e.g.: Aug 06, 2012)<br>- `TIME`: Time (e.g.: 2:03 PM)<br>- `HOUR_MINUTE`: Hours & minutes (e.g.: 29 hours 47 minutes)<br>- `DAY_HOUR_MINUTE`: Days & hours & minutes (e.g.: 1 day 5 hours 47 minutes)<br>If ignored, `NUMBER` will be set.|
|unitPosition|string|false|none|The display position of the Currency.<br>- `BEFORE`: The currency will be displayed before the field value.<br>- `AFTER`: The currency will be displayed after the field value.<br>If ignored, `BEFORE` will be set.|
|label|string|false|none|The field name.|
|type|string|true|none|The field type.<br>- `GROUP`: Group<br>- `GROUP_SELECT`: Group selection<br>- `CALC`: Calculated<br>- `CHECK_BOX`: Check box<br>- `DATE`: Date<br>- `DATETIME`: Date and time<br>- `DROP_DOWN`: Drop-down<br>- `FILE`: Attachment<br>- `LINK`: Link<br>- `MULTI_LINE_TEXT`: Text Area<br>- `MULTI_SELECT`: Multi-choice<br>- `NUMBER`: Number<br>- `ORGANIZATION_SELECT`: Department selection<br>- `RADIO_BUTTON`: Radio button<br>- `RECORD_NUMBER`: Record number<br>- `REFERENCE_TABLE`: Related Records<br>- `RICH_TEXT`: Rich text<br>- `SINGLE_LINE_TEXT`: Text<br>- `SUBTABLE`: Table<br>- `TIME`: Time<br>- `USER_SELECT`: User selection<br>For Lookup fields, specify depending on the Key field type it's looking up.|
|displayScale|integer(int64)|false|none|The number of decimal places to display for the field.|
|hideExpression|boolean|false|none|The **Hide formula** settings for the field.<br>- `true`: The formula will be hidden.<br>- `false`: The formula will be displayed.<br>If ignored, `false` will be set.|
|required|boolean|false|none|The **Required field** option.<br>- `true`: The field will be a required field.<br>- `false`: The field will not be a required field.<br>If ignored, `false` will be set.|

An object with data of the settings of the options.
Specify the current option names for this parameter. Options that are not specified will be deleted.
Required if setting the `properties.{fieldcode}.options` parameter.
If a new option is specified for this parameter, it will be treated as a new option.

|label|string|false|none|The display name of the option.<br>Specify the same value as `{optionname}`.<br>Required if setting the `properties.{fieldcode}.options` parameter.|

|recordAdded|boolean|false|none|Option to notify the entity when a record is added.<br>- `true`: Notify when a record is added<br>- `false`: Do not notify when a record is added<br>If ignored, this value is false.|
|statusChanged|boolean|false|none|Option to notify the entity when a status is changed.<br>- `true`: Notify when a status is changed<br>- `false`: Do not notify when a status is changed<br>If ignored, this value is false.|
|includeSubs|boolean|false|none|The "Include affiliated departments" setting of the Department. This parameter is available if **notifications[].entity.type** parameter is specified to **ORGANIZATION** or **FIELD_ENTITY**.<br>- `true`: Affiliated departments do inherit the General Notification settings<br>- `false`: Affiliated departments do not inherit the General Notification settings<br>If ignored, this value is false.|

|commentAdded|boolean|false|none|Option to notify the entity when a comment is posted.<br>- `true`: Notify when a comment is posted<br>- `false`: Do not notify when a comment is posted<br>If ignored, this value is false.|

<h2 id="tocS_PreviewAppReportsPutPeriodicReport">PreviewAppReportsPutPeriodicReport</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapreviewappreportsputperiodicreport"></a>
<a id="schema_PreviewAppReportsPutPeriodicReport"></a>
<a id="tocSpreviewappreportsputperiodicreport"></a>
<a id="tocspreviewappreportsputperiodicreport"></a>

```json
{
  "period": {
    "month": 0,
    "dayOfMonth": 0,
    "time": "string",
    "every": "YEAR"
  },
  "active": true
}
```

An object containing the "Periodic Reports" options.
If the "Periodic Reports" option is active, no graph settings can be updated except for the following:
- **reports.{graphname}.name**
- **reports.{graphname}.index**
- **reports.{graphname}.periodicReport.active**
If this parameter is ignored, no changes will be made to the "Periodic Reports" options.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|period|object|false|none|An object containing the "Period" options.<br>When updating the Periodic Report, either ignore this parameter or keep the parameters the same. Otherwise, an error will be returned.<br>Required when adding a new graph.|
|active|boolean|false|none|The activation status of the "Periodic Reports" option.<br>- `true`: Active<br>- `false`: Inactive<br>If this parameter is ignored when creating a new Periodic Report, this value is set to true.<br>If this parameter is ignored when updating an existing Periodic Report, this value is not updated.|

<h2 id="tocS_PreviewAppReportsPutReport">PreviewAppReportsPutReport</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapreviewappreportsputreport"></a>
<a id="schema_PreviewAppReportsPutReport"></a>
<a id="tocSpreviewappreportsputreport"></a>
<a id="tocspreviewappreportsputreport"></a>

```json
{
  "periodicReport": {
    "period": {
      "month": 0,
      "dayOfMonth": 0,
      "time": "string",
      "every": "YEAR"
    },
    "active": true
  },
  "chartType": "PIE",
  "name": "string",
  "index": 0,
  "groups": [
    {
      "code": "string",
      "per": "YEAR"
    }
  ],
  "filterCond": "string",
  "aggregations": [
    {
      "type": "COUNT"
    }
  ],
  "sorts": [
    {
      "by": "TOTAL",
      "order": "ASC"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|periodicReport|[PreviewAppReportsPutPeriodicReport](#schemapreviewappreportsputperiodicreport)|false|none|An object containing the "Periodic Reports" options.<br>If the "Periodic Reports" option is active, no graph settings can be updated except for the following:<br>- **reports.{graphname}.name**<br>- **reports.{graphname}.index**<br>- **reports.{graphname}.periodicReport.active**<br>If this parameter is ignored, no changes will be made to the "Periodic Reports" options.|
|chartType|string|true|none|The chart type of the graph. For more information, refer to the following article:<br>[Chart Types and Their Usage](https://us.kintone.help/k/en/id/040581)<br>- **BAR**: Bar chart<br>- **COLUMN**: Column chart<br>- **PIE**: Pie chart<br>- **LINE**: Line chart<br>- **PIVOT_TABLE**: Pivot Table<br>- **TABLE**: Table<br>- **AREA**: Area chart<br>- **SPLINE**: Spline chart<br>- **SPLINE_AREA**: Spline area chart<br>Required when updating an existing graph, or creating a new graph.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the graph.<br>1 to 64 characters can be specified.<br>When adding a new graph, the request will fail if the value of this parameter is not the same as **reports.{graphname}**.<br>Required when adding a new graph.|
|index|integer(int64)|true|none|The order of the graphs.<br>The graph is sorted in ascending order, starting from 0.<br>The request will fail if there are duplicate values.<br>Required when updating an existing graph, or creating a new graph.|
|groups|[[PreviewAppReportsPutGroup](#schemapreviewappreportsputgroup)]|false|none|An array of objects containing the "Group by" options.<br>The order of the objects are in the order of "Level 1", "Level 2", and "Level 3".<br>The request will fail if the **reports.{graphname}.chartType** parameter is set to **PIVOT_TABLE** and **reports.{graphname}.groups** has less than one object.<br>Required when adding a new graph.|
|filterCond|string(query)|false|none|The record's filter condition in query string format that reflects the "Filter" option.<br>For more information on query formats refer to the following document:<br>[Query String](https://kintone.dev/en/docs/kintone/overview/query-string/)<br>There are restrictions on the conditions that can be specified:<br>[Available Operators and Functions for Each Field](https://kintone.dev/en/id/0d9792ee2b6e4b0e3829c9ee/#available-operators-and-functions-for-each-field)<br>If this parameter is ignored for a new graph, it is the same as when "All records" is specified.<br>If this parameter is ignored for an existing graph, the filter setting will not be changed.<br>The request will fail if a deleted User, Group, or Organization is specified in the filter condition.|
|aggregations|[object]|false|none|An array of objects containing the "Function" options.<br>The maximum limit is 10 elements in the array.<br>If the **reports.{graphname}.chartType** parameter is set to **PIVOT_TABLE**, only 1 element can be set in the array.<br>Required when adding a new graph.|
|sorts|[[PreviewAppReportsPutSort](#schemapreviewappreportsputsort)]|false|none|An array of objects containing the "Sort by" options.<br>The maximum limit is 3 elements in the array.<br>Required when adding a new graph.|

|Property|Value|

|chartType|LINE|
|chartType|SPLINE|
|chartType|TABLE|
|chartType|PIVOT_TABLE|
|chartType|BAR|
|chartType|COLUMN|
|chartType|AREA|
|chartType|SPLINE_AREA|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapreviewappstatusputstateform"></a>
<a id="schema_PreviewAppStatusPutStateForm"></a>
<a id="tocSpreviewappstatusputstateform"></a>
<a id="tocspreviewappstatusputstateform"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "index": 0,
  "assignee": {
    "entities": [
      {
        "includeSubs": true,
        "entity": {
          "code": "string",
          "type": "USER"
        }
      }
    ],
    "type": "ONE"
  }
}
```

An object containing the settings of each status.
- Add a new status: Specify a status name that does not exist.
- Update a status: Specify the name of the status to be updated.
- Delete a status: Do not specify the status name for deletion.
The first status cannot be added. To change the first status, update the name of the existing first status.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|The status name.<br>The maximum length is 64 characters.<br>Required, if stating a new status for `{status_name}`. In this case, state the same value used for `{status_name}`.|
|index|integer(int64)|true|none|The display order (ascending from 0) of the Status, when listed with the other statuses. Required, if setting the `{status_name}` parameter.|
|assignee|object|false|none|An object containing data of the Assignee settings.|

```json
{
```
```json
  "viewable": true,
  "editable": true,
  "deletable": true,
  "includeSubs": true,
  "entity": {
    "code": "string",
    "type": "USER"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|viewable|boolean|false|none|The view permission of the entity.<br>- `true`: Grant view permission<br>- `false`: Deny view permission<br>If ignored, the value is false.|
|editable|boolean|false|none|The edit permission of the entity.<br>- `true`: Grant edit permission<br>- `false`: Deny edit permission<br>If ignored, this value is false.<br>If the entity has no permission to view the record, this value is false.|
|deletable|boolean|false|none|The delete permission of the entity.<br>- `true`: Grant delete permission<br>- `false`: Deny delete permission<br>If ignored, this value is false.<br>If the entity has no permission to view the record, this value is false.|
|includeSubs|boolean|false|none|The permission inheritance settings of the department the permissions are granted to.<br>- `true`: Permissions are inherited.<br>- `false`: Permissions are not inherited.<br>If ignored, this value is false.|
|entity|object|true|none|An object containing data of the entity the permissions are granted to.|

<h2 id="tocS_RecordWritableObject">RecordWritableObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarecordwritableobject"></a>
<a id="schema_RecordWritableObject"></a>
<a id="tocSrecordwritableobject"></a>
<a id="tocsrecordwritableobject"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "CHECK_BOX",
  "value": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

The value of a single field when writing a record.

**Always an object with a `value` property, never a bare value.**

```
correct: { "fieldCode": { "value": "ABC" } }
wrong:   { "fieldCode": "ABC" }
```

Sending a bare value returns HTTP 400. `type` is optional; when omitted, the App's field settings are used.

The shape of `value` depends on the field type, which `GET /k/v1/app/form/fields.json` reports:

| Field type | shape of `value` |
|---|---|
| Single-line text, Multi-line text, Rich text, Link, Number, Date, Time, Date and time, Drop-down, Radio button | string — numbers and dates are strings too, e.g. `"1200000"`, `"2026-08-31"` |
| Check box, Multi-choice | array of strings, each matching one of the App's choices exactly |
| User selection, Department selection, Group selection | array of `{ "code": "..." }` |
| Attachment | array of `{ "fileKey": "..." }` — upload the file first to obtain a key |
| Table | array of `{ "id": "...", "value": { "<fieldCode>": { "value": ... } } }` |

To clear a field, send an empty string for the text-like types, or an empty array for the array types.

**A field code that does not exist in the App is silently ignored.** The request still returns HTTP 200 and a new revision, so a typo looks like success even though nothing changed. Copy the codes from `GET /k/v1/app/form/fields.json` exactly.

**Table and Attachment fields are replaced, not merged.** When updating an existing record, every table row and every `fileKey` the request does not list is deleted. To change one cell of a table, send the whole table including the `id` of each row to keep. Fields left out of the request entirely are untouched.
